bioMarkdown:
Hello, I'm Zhao Chen 👋👋, a Master's student in Biomedical Engineering (BME) at ![CityU Logo](/icon/cityu.png) [City University of Hong Kong (CityU)](https://www.cityu.edu.hk/). 

My learning journey has been a bit **unconventional** 😂: Undergraduate background rooted in the interdisciplinary field of **Medical Informatics**; later developed a passion for **Computer Vision (CV)**, self-taught OpenCV, deep learning-based image detection/segmentation/human pose estimation, and attempted to solve few-shot segmentation problems; now fully immersed in the world of **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, exploring the intersection of natural language processing and biomedical engineering. For more details about my background, feel free to check my [resume](./resume.pdf). 

💻 **Recent Learning & Projects:** 
- Systematically mastered core principles of LLMs, from Transformer architecture to pre-training/fine-tuning workflows, and built & implemented a ChatGPT-2 model from scratch using PyTorch; 
- currently working :
  1.  Develop an Agentic RAG based on LangGraph + Llama Index 
  2.  Develop a personal assistant based on OpenClaw 
- Two completed projects:
  1.  Enterprise RAG System (Addressing intelligent retrieval and Q&A needs for internal enterprise documents)
  2.  AI Search Application (Enabling fast retrieval of massive data with Elasticsearch (ES)); 
  3.  Develop an autonomous browser agent based on the OpenManus architecture 
- future exploration focus: The potential of **Small Language Models (SLMs)**; 
- detailed learning notes, reproduction codes, and more are available on my [GitHub](https://github.com/chenzhao-labs). 

🔍 **Career Goal:** To integrate my interdisciplinary background in medical-engineering and LLM expertise, exploring the practical applications of AI in healthcare, and becoming a cross-disciplinary engineer proficient in both healthcare and algorithms. 

🔬 **Research Interests:** Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI)
